name: 49887-specdecode-qwen35moe122b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 -- apache-2.0, ungated, 39 safetensors shards, 127.2 GB on disk, NOT in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole node, all eight GPUs.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. Forced: 127 GB of weights does not fit fewer cards at this operating point, and 8 divides the model's 64 linear-attention value heads and 16 key heads.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 49887. The 256-stream operating point is part of the declaration: this is a large-batch decode setup and a run at small batch measures nothing.
workload: REAL GSM8K test questions -- `openai/gsm8k`, config `main`, split `test`, the `question` column, 1319 rows, cycled by the loader to fill the batch. Greedy (temperature 0), `max_tokens: 256` with `ignore_eos: true`, so every sequence emits exactly 256 tokens. Prompts are sent as plain question text, not through the checkpoint's chat template. Real prose is required and must not be swapped for synthetic tokens: a drafter's acceptance rate is a property of real text.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor answering word problems for 256 concurrent students with a 122-billion-parameter model on eight GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
dtype: auto
kv-cache-dtype: auto
mamba-ssm-cache-dtype: float32

# Selects the PREFILL kernel for the linear-attention layers only; pinned rather than left to
# `auto`, which on SM90 picks a kernel that JIT-compiles on first use.
gdn-prefill-backend: triton

language-model-only: true
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# the data sampler's seed is separate and lives in scenario.json
seed: 0

speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

# MUST STAY ONE LINE OF INLINE JSON: written block-style this key parses to nothing, the engine is
# built with no capture ladder, and the run still exits 0 -- silently in eager decode. A
# speculative step is 256 x 4 = 1024 token slots in one uniform-decode batch, above vLLM's default
# ceiling, and capture sizes that are not multiples of the window abort at some batch/window pairs.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024], "max_cudagraph_capture_size": 1024}

# kept so the engine's speculative counters are emitted
disable-log-stats: false
